archiveTitle: Daily Brief | STRANGER THAN HEAVEN confirms Bunta Sugawara and Tupac as digital characters

entries.headline: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition – The Viking Sagas is now available
entries.summary: Xbox Wire says Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition – The Viking Sagas is now available. The immutable packet only establishes the official launch headline and does not provide platform, pricing, or content details, so this item does not add any.
entries.verification: The opened Xbox Wire primary source confirms the product name and its 'Available Now' status; no platform or content details are inferred beyond the source.
entries.timeNote: The Xbox Wire page was published at 02:00 Beijing time on September 24, inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: CONTROL Resonant details melee combat, regional progression, and a nonlinear Manhattan
entries.summary: Remedy's Xbox Wire article describes Dylan Faden as a melee-focused protagonist with a large skill tree, weapon forms, secondary weapons, combat abilities, and combo finishers. Manhattan is built from dense nonlinear regions whose levels rise through combat, secrets, and missions; defeating Resonant Entities makes those regions more dangerous.
entries.verification: The opened Xbox Wire primary article is the source for the combat, progression, and regional-structure details; promotional judgments are not presented as independent conclusions.
entries.timeNote: The Xbox Wire page was published at 21:00 Beijing time on September 23, inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: STRANGER THAN HEAVEN confirms Bunta Sugawara and Tupac as digital characters
entries.summary: SEGA says the late actor Bunta Sugawara was recreated as a CG character with his family's consent and materials supplied by Toei. Tupac plays Amaru under continuing supervision from Amaru Entertainment, and the character design did not use AI. The game follows Makoto Daito across five cities from 1915 to 1965 and is due January 15, 2027.
entries.verification: The opened SEGA-authored Xbox Wire article directly supports the permissions, source materials, no-AI statement, story span, and release date.
entries.timeNote: The Xbox Wire page was published at 10:01 Beijing time on September 24, before the 10:10 cutoff.

entries.headline: Super Danganronpa 2×2 reveals a new Madness Mode character voiced by Natsuki Hanae
entries.summary: Spike Chunsoft revealed a new character for Super Danganronpa 2×2's Madness Mode, voiced by Natsuki Hanae; the character's Ultimate talent remains undisclosed. The game is planned for January 14, 2027 on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam, and Epic Games Store.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON and Denfaminicogamer reports both explicitly relay the official announcement and agree on the character reveal, voice actor, mode, release date, and platforms.
entries.timeNote: The later opened report was published at 09:51 Beijing time on September 24; the other was published at 09:07, and both are before the cutoff.

entries.headline: WWE abandons its 'Vice City' trademark application, with the reason undisclosed
entries.summary: IGN reports from trademark records that WWE filed a 'Vice City' application on August 8 and that it was marked dead on September 21. The report could not confirm why WWE abandoned it; speculation involving wrestler Lola Vice or Rockstar Games is not treated as fact here.
entries.verification: Only the opened IGN report is used; the filing and dead-status dates follow the trademark records it cites, while the reason for abandonment remains unknown.
entries.timeNote: The IGN page was published at 19:33 Beijing time on September 23, inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: ARC Raiders' largest update, Frozen Trail, launches October 8
entries.summary: Nexon announced the ARC Raiders update Frozen Trail for October 8 and described it as the game's largest update since launch. It adds the Pendra Pass map, the fallen giant ARC called Emperor, enemies including Bully, Stalker, and Hydra, and gear such as the Grappling Hook, Tether Launcher, and Young Grenade.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly relays Nexon's official announcement; the date, update positioning, map, enemy names, and equipment names all come from that report.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON page was published at 08:15 Beijing time on September 24, inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Rakugaki Kingdom 2 developer says he is making 'something like Rakugaki Kingdom'
entries.summary: Black Belt Games head and former Rakugaki Kingdom 2 game designer Yuichi Tanzawa said on the game's 22nd anniversary that he is working on 'something like Rakugaki Kingdom.' He did not disclose a project name, publisher, platforms, or schedule, so this is not treated as an official sequel announcement.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report relays Yuichi Tanzawa's original wording; the packet provides no formal project identity, publishing entity, platform list, or timeline.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON page was published at 17:03 Beijing time on September 23, inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: 2D action game AVELUNE announced with a customizable support robot
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that solo developer Skyho announced the 2D action game AVELUNE on September 23 for PC via Steam. Players explore the ruined kingdom of Avel and a giant tower that fell from the sky, configuring skills and a support robot for combat and exploration.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report supports the announcement, developer, PC Steam platform, and core gameplay details; its descriptions are not upgraded into first-party confirmation.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON page was published at 12:19 Beijing time on September 23, inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: JSAUX announces two display-equipped replacement faceplates for Steam Machine
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that JSAUX GAMING announced the E-Ink Faceplate for $99.99 and the Pixel Matrix Faceplate for $89.99, both planned to begin shipping in early October. The panels can show information such as the clock, weather, or device status.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report is the source for the product names, prices, and shipping window; no additional compatibility or sales-region claims are inferred.

entries.headline: BlazBlue: Entropy Effect X launches its Fall 2026 major free update
entries.summary: Gematsu reports that Astrolabe Games and 91Act released the Fall 2026 major free content update for BlazBlue: Entropy Effect X. It adds elite enemies Nine the Phantom and The Lost Gearhulk plus the stage Remains; the Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch versions will receive the update later.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report explicitly relays the update information from publisher Astrolabe Games and developer 91Act, including the later timing for the Switch 2 and Switch versions.
entries.timeNote: The Gematsu page was published at 10:00 Beijing time on September 24, before the 10:10 cutoff.

entries.summary: Gematsu reports that AMATA Games announced Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney – Dual Destinies VR under license from Capcom. It is planned for 2027 on Quest and Meta VR Glasses and will support Simplified Chinese among its languages.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report explicitly relays AMATA Games' announcement, including the licensing relationship, target platforms, 2027 release window, and language support.

entries.headline: Tetris Effect: Mixed Realities announced for Quest 3 and Meta VR Glasses
entries.summary: Gematsu reports that publisher Enhance and developers Monstars and Resonair announced Tetris Effect: Mixed Realities for release in 2027 on Quest 3 and Meta VR Glasses. The mixed-reality design changes the player's surrounding space alongside the game's scenes.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu report explicitly relays Enhance's announcement; the announcing parties, platforms, and 2027 release window come from that report.
entries.timeNote: The Gematsu page was published at 08:53 Beijing time on September 24, inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: Discord relaunches age assurance using account signals before extra verification
entries.summary: Game Developer reports that Discord is relaunching its age-verification policy eight months after its first rollout. The system first uses account-level signals such as account age and payment methods to estimate whether a user is an adult or teen; Discord CTO Stanislav Vishnevskiy says more than 90% of existing users will not need additional verification, with credit card, app-store, and AgeKey methods among the new options.
entries.verification: The opened Game Developer report explicitly attributes the policy mechanics and the 'more than 90%' statement to Discord CTO and co-founder Stanislav Vishnevskiy.
entries.timeNote: The Game Developer page was published at 02:30 Beijing time on September 24, inside this edition's fixed window.

entries.headline: The Convenience Store launches on Nintendo Switch 2 with new ending content
entries.summary: 4Gamer reports that the Nintendo Switch 2 version of Chilla's Art horror game The Convenience Store began distribution on September 24 and adds new ending content.
entries.verification: The opened 4Gamer report supports only the Switch 2 launch and the addition of new ending content; promotional pricing is not used as the headline focus.
entries.timeNote: The 4Gamer RSS/page time converts to 23:00 Beijing time on September 23, inside this edition's fixed window; the report's 'today' refers to September 24 in Japan.
